note: Files below are the original published figure images, downloaded directly from the PMC-hosted article (cdn.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/blobs/...). Each figure except F1 now has a sibling *.estimated.json with values read by visual inspection, provenance='estimated', and an explicit confidence note. F1 (MRF) remains unreadable at usable confidence -- its source image is low-resolution (400x166px). None of these have been run through an actual calibrated tool (WebPlotDigitizer or equivalent) with registered axis-calibration points; that upgrade from 'estimated' to 'digitized' is still open work before any of this data should be treated as production-grade. Clean bar charts (F3, F4, F5) are moderate-high confidence; overlapping line charts (F2, and F1 if ever revisited) are low-to-moderate confidence, especially for distinguishing the 2/4/6-puff active conditions from each other.

figures.caption: Representative subjective ratings of marijuana quality as a function of number of active puffs and time as measured by the MRF (0 mm = not at all; 100 mm = extremely). Data presented as average group values for each post-smoking time point (+/- SEM). Active marijuana increased subjective ratings (0 puffs < 2, 4, or 6 puffs; p<=.001); dose-dependent effects were not observed.

Representative subjective ratings of drug effect as a function of number of active puffs and time as measured by the SE-VAS (0 mm = not at all; 100 mm = extremely). Data presented as average group values for each post-smoking time point (+/- SEM). Active marijuana increased subjective ratings ('high' p<=.001, 'stimulated' p<=.05), but not dose-dependently.
figures.priority: highest -- this is the primary series for Exhibit 001 (Dose x Time explorer, 'high' track)

figures.caption: Ratings for 'I want marijuana' on the SE-VAS as a function of number of active puffs (0 mm = not at all; 100 mm = extremely). Data presented as average group values across all post-smoking time points (+/- SEM). Significance markers vs 0-puff condition included in the original figure (*, **, ***).
figures.y_axis: VAS rating, 0-100 mm, averaged across timepoints

figures.caption: Heart rate (bpm) and expired carbon monoxide (ppm) as a function of number of active puffs and time. Data presented as mean values (+/- SEM) across all post-smoking time points. Dual-axis or paired-panel figure -- confirm layout during digitization.
figures.x_axis: active puffs: 0, 2, 4, 6 (averaged across timepoints per caption)

figures.caption: Amount of marijuana cigarettes smoked, depicted as difference between pre-smoking and post-smoking cigarette weights, by cigarette position (1st/2nd/3rd) and puff condition.
figures.y_axis: weight smoked (mg, unconfirmed -- verify unit on axis during digitization)
